Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F00245725
Sheriff’s File # 26000559
PLAINTIFF – Alliant Credit Union vs:
DEFENDANTS- Jesse P. Casey
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 22nd day of June, 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Neptune City, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Tax Lot: 89 Block: 12 Located on the tax map of the City of Neptune
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
90 Ridge Terrace Neptune City, NJ 07753
Dimensions of Lot (Approximately) 50 x 100
Nearest Cross Street:Ridge Place
Subject to:
SEE CONDITIONS OF SALE
1) "The short form description provided herein does not constitute a full legal description. A full legal description is available in the Office of the Monmouth County Sheriff"
2) The Estimated Upset Amount at the time of the sale is $108,464.39 which amount is subject to change in the event of any Monetary Advances incurred by Plaintiff and/or Orders for Additional Sums entered by the Court, without further publication
3) Upon information and belief, current Occupancy Status of this property is "UNKNOWN"
Sale is subject to the following Mortgages/Liens:
1) Mortgage with Hidden Handvor, LLC in the amount of $125,000.00.
2) Mortgage with Nationstar Mortgage, LLC in the amount of $356,688.00
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $107,913.35.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: March 20, 2026
Leopold & Associates, PLLC
80 Business Park Drive
Suite 110
Armonk, NY 10504
914-219-5787
